ferraPage.tagline: A world to rebuild, a fire to protect, a meteor to face. Mine, automate, defend your camp — and get ready for the night.

about.title: A survival game that never stops
about.p1: From pickaxe in hand to electric drills, from the skill tree to professions, every FERRA run is built tile by tile. Protect your campfire, gather iron, wood, stone and copper, then automate everything with drills — classic or electric, powered by a real grid (solar panels, wind turbines, generators, a nuclear plant, batteries).
about.p2: By day, you gather and build. At night, monsters roam. And in the distance, a meteor approaches — build your bunker or bet on evacuation, every choice has real consequences.

features.f1: Full gathering and automation — from hand-mining to electric drills
features.f2: A complete power grid: solar, wind, generator, nuclear, batteries
features.f3: Skill tree and a Professions system with real rewards
features.f4: Day/night cycle — turrets, barracks and a torch to survive the night
features.f5: Bunker Tycoon or Evacuation when the meteor strikes, with a real narrative follow-up
features.f6: Community forum and a unified player account
features.moreLink: 📖 See all the info & the full changelog →

tdPage.tagline: Endless zombie waves, elemental towers to combine into real synergies, and weather that changes everything mid-fight.

about.title: Classic at heart, never-ending in practice
about.p1: Tower Defense Infinite starts from a base you already know: place towers, slow enemies, hold the line. Cannon and Archer tower to start — then very quickly, the game changes nature. The waves never end, and to hold on you'll need to unlock and combine elemental towers: ice to slow, fire to burn over time, poison to wear down, glue to root in place. Each has its strengths, and the real combos appear when you make them work together.
about.p2: Dynamic weather disrupts the battlefield mid-run, and a Prestige system lets you restart with permanent bonuses once the current wave gets too hard — to come back stronger, again and again.

features.f1: Endless waves — the game never stops, difficulty keeps climbing
features.f2: 10 towers to unlock by playing: Cannon, Archer, Ice, Fire, Wind, Tesla, Poison, Military Barracks, Glue, and the Prestige Tower
features.f3: Real synergies between elements — combine ice + fire, poison + glue and many more combos
features.f4: Dynamic weather that directly affects combat
features.f5: Prestige system with permanent bonuses (+% gold, game speed, a special map)
features.f6: 34 achievements to unlock, detailed stats (combat, defense, economy, dedication...)
features.f7: Built-in wiki — zombies, towers, synergies and cursed waves, all explained in-game
features.f8: Cursed waves and bosses to break the routine

acPage.tagline: Click, unlock, embody your favorite anime universes — Naruto, One Piece, My Hero Academia and many more to come, each with its own upgrades.
acPage.screenVal: All formats — mobile to Full HD

about.title: A clicker that crosses universes
about.p1: Anime Clicker takes the classic clicker formula — click to progress, unlock upgrades, let it run automatically — and dresses it up with the best-known anime universes. Start in the Naruto universe: gather chakra by clicking, unlock Shadow Clone or Rasengan for automatic production, and get ready for Sage Mode.
about.p2: Other universes — One Piece, My Hero Academia, and many more — unlock as you progress, each with its own upgrades and visual atmosphere. A Reincarnation system lets you restart everything for permanent bonuses once a universe is well underway.

features.f1: Several anime universes to unlock by playing — Naruto, One Piece, My Hero Academia and more to come
features.f2: Themed upgrades specific to each universe (clicks and automatic production)
features.f3: Reincarnation (prestige) system to push further on every run
features.f5: Auto-save — pick up exactly where you left off
features.f6: Adapts to every screen, from mobile to Full HD

faqPage.heading: ❓ Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.sub: Installation, Windows security, accounts, profiles, games — answers to the most common questions.
faqPage.searchPlaceholder: 🔍 Search a keyword (e.g. antivirus, password, avatar...)
faqPage.noResults: No question matches — try another word, or ask your question on the forum.

q1.q: Windows shows "Windows protected your PC" (SmartScreen) — is it a virus?
q1.a:
No, that's normal and safe. This message appears on any independent software not digitally signed by a publisher recognized by Microsoft — a signing certificate costs several hundred euros a year, out of reach for a small independent project for now.

To continue: click "More info" (a small grey link under the message), then "Run anyway". This doesn't disable any protection on your PC — it's just a one-time permission for this specific file.

q2.q: I don't see a "More info" link, just an OK button — what do I do?
q2.a:
That means Windows protection is set to "Block" instead of "Warn". Admin mode changes nothing here, a setting needs adjusting:

1. Open Windows Security (search in the Start menu)
2. App & browser control
3. Under Reputation-based protection, open its settings
4. Switch "Check apps and files" from Block to Warn
5. Restart the installer — the "More info" link should now appear.

q3.q: My antivirus (Windows Defender or other) removes the file or quarantines it
q3.a:
This is a false positive: antivirus software is wary by default of unsigned, rarely downloaded executables, even when they contain nothing malicious. If this happens:

• Restore the file from your antivirus quarantine
• Or add an exception for IzackiLauncher-Setup.exe before re-downloading

If you'd rather not, that's completely understandable — let us know on the forum, we'll look into where it's coming from.

q4.q: The browser flat out blocks the file download
q4.a: Some browsers (Edge, Chrome) show a warning before the file is even saved, something like "This file is unusual and could be dangerous." Click the three dots ( ⋯ ) next to the download in the browser bar, then choose "Keep" / "Keep anyway".

q5.q: Where does the Launcher install games?
q5.a: By default in the app's data folder (hidden, managed automatically). You can change this location in Settings → Storage → Change folder from the Launcher — your already-installed games will be moved automatically, no need to re-download them.

q1.q: Do the Launcher and the site use the same account?
q1.a: Yes — a single account for the forum, the site and the Launcher. No need to sign up again everywhere.

q2.q: I forgot my password, what do I do?
q2.a: From the forum login screen, use the password recovery link. Since the Launcher uses the same account, a new password will work in both places.

q3.a: It's your unique Discord-style identifier — your username followed by a number assigned when your account was created. It lets people add you as a friend unambiguously, even if someone else picked the same username. It's visible top-right of the Launcher and in Settings, and can never be changed (unlike your display name).

q1.q: How do I change my banner or avatar?
q1.a:
In the Launcher, Settings → My Profile: click directly on the frame (banner) or the circle overlapping it (avatar) to upload your own image, or pick one of the visuals provided by the launcher right below — no upload needed in that case.

Recommended sizes: banner 1200 × 300 px, avatar 512 × 512 px (square preferred).

q2.q: My display name is different from my username, is that normal?
q2.a: Yes. Your username#number (e.g. Izacki#1) is your permanent identifier, never changeable. Your display name is what other players see on your profile and can be changed freely in Settings → My Profile — if empty, your username#number shows instead.

q3.a: A private profile hides your banner, achievements and playtime from other players — only your tag (username#number) stays visible, needed so your friends can find you. It's a one-click toggle in Settings → My Profile.

q1.q: How do I install a game?
q1.a: From the Store tab, click a game to see its page (description, screenshots) then click Install. Once installed, find it in My Games with a real Play button to launch it directly.

q2.q: My achievements don't show on the game's page
q2.a: Achievements only sync when the game is launched from the Launcher (not via a direct shortcut to the executable). Also make sure you're logged in before starting a run.

q3.q: How do I quit a game cleanly?
q3.a: Press Escape in-game to open the pause menu, then Quit game — your progress is saved automatically before closing.

q4.q: How do I uninstall a game?
q4.a: From My Games, click the game's card then the 🗑 icon next to the Play button. You can also see the space used by each game in Settings → Storage.

q5.a: All current games (FERRA, Tower Defense Infinite, Anime Clicker) are free. Some future games may be paid, purchasable directly from the Launcher.

q1.q: How do I know if an update is available?
q1.a: The Launcher automatically blocks you if you try to launch an outdated game, and redirects you to the Download tab. You can also turn on the "Automatic updates" switch in that tab to never think about it again.

q2.q: Does the Launcher itself update on its own?
q2.a: Yes, it checks automatically on startup and installs itself if a new version exists — you never need to manually re-download the installer (except for an exceptional internal security change, announced on the forum).
